title: Why Your $2 Raise Actually Costs You $12,000
hook: Millions of workers are turning down promotions on purpose — and when you see the math, it's actually the smartest move they can make.
angle: The benefits cliff trap: crossing a government income threshold by even $1 can eliminate $13,000+ in annual benefits, making a raise a net financial loss
audience: Low-to-middle income workers, parents on assistance, anyone near a government benefit threshold
key_numbers: $13,000+ in benefits at risk (SNAP, Medicaid, childcare, housing)
net loss of $9,000 for accepting a raise
